---
name: Bug report
about: Report incorrect behaviour with a minimal reproduction
---

**What happened and what did you expect?**

**Steps to reproduce**

Use synthetic documents where possible. Include the remile version, macOS version and Mac model. Note whether the issue involves Git, a local file or an optional connection.

**Evidence**

Attach sanitised screenshots or logs only. Remove tokens, passwords, private documents and account details. For security vulnerabilities, follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/PentagonToy/remile/blob/main/SECURITY.md) instead of posting exploit details here.
